description.en: Petra and the caravan lands south and east of the Dead Sea; Nabataean presence in the Hauran from the 3rd century BCE.
description.ar: البتراء وأراضي القوافل جنوب البحر الميت وشرقه؛ وجود نبطي في حوران منذ القرن الثالث ق.م.
description.he: פטרה ואדמות השיירות מדרום לים המלח וממזרחו; נוכחות נבטית בחורן מהמאה ה-3 לפנה״ס.

sources.quote: whose settlements lay in the borderlands between Syria and Arabia, from the Euphrates River to the Red Sea
Nabateans have been present in the Hauran since the 3rd century BCE

description.en: Aretas III took over Damascus and "Coele Syria" at the request of its inhabitants.
description.ar: استولى الحارث الثالث على دمشق و'Coele Syria' [سوريا الجوفاء] بناءً على طلب سكانها.
description.he: חרתת השלישי השתלט על דמשק ועל “Coele Syria” [סוריה החלולה] לבקשת תושביה.

sources.quote: motivated the inhabitants of Damascus to request of Aretas III to take control of Coile Syria in 85–72 BCE
shortly after 85 bc their king Aretas III ruled Damascus and Coele Syria (Lebanon)

notes.en: Britannica says Aretas kept Damascus after 63 BCE and that it was later annexed by Nero; Dar limits the takeover to 85–72 BCE.

description.en: Core kingdom with the southern Hauran; northern Hauran passed to Herod in 23 BCE.
description.ar: المملكة الأساسية مع جنوب حوران؛ وانتقل شمال حوران إلى هيرودس عام 23 ق.م.
description.he: הממלכה המרכזית עם דרום חורן; צפון חורן עבר להורדוס ב-23 לפנה״ס.

sources.quote: the situation did not change even after the Roman conquest of Syria in 64 BCE
From 23 BCE, when Augustus awarded Herod control of the Hauran

notes.en: Damascus status after 72 BCE contested (see previous slice).
